description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Bolts for the Door Hinges.
Comes with the Exact Quantity Needed to Replace ALL Door Hinge Screws.
Makes the Appearance more Rugged
Replaces the Hard-To-Remove Screws
NOTE: Metal Finish May Vary between Bright Zinc or Phosphate (Zinc Shown)
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 16 – Hinge Bolts, Door (4 per Hinge)
What Will this Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
